text: CEVA Logistics, Scuderia Ferrari HP's Premium Partner and Official Logistics Provider, has been a subsidiary of the French CMA CGM Group since 2019.
short: CEVA Logistics has been a CMA CGM subsidiary since 2019.

source.name: Wikipedia – CEVA Logistics
source.quote: It has been a CMA CGM subsidiary since 2019, who acquired and merged other companies into CEVA
